description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


# Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.4.1

- Add cloud-shaped thought bubbles to your screenshots. / 新增云朵形思考气泡标注。
- Use Enter and numeric-keypad Enter consistently with your shortcuts. / 统一主键盘与数字键盘 Enter 快捷键行为。
- Open large images more reliably for editing, stitching, and splitting. / 改善大图导入、编辑、拼图及分割的稳定性。
- Recognize imported images correctly even when their file extension is missing or incorrect. / 即使扩展名缺失或错误，也能正确识别导入的图片。
- Pick accurate image colors without selection outlines affecting the result. / 修复选区边框干扰取色结果的问题。
- Reduce startup memory use by loading drawing resources when needed. / 绘图资源按需加载，减少启动时的内存占用。

## Quick macOS install / macOS 快速安装

Run in Terminal without `sudo`; add `--edition mini` to install Mini. / 复制到终端运行，无需添加 `sudo`；末尾添加 `--edition mini` 可安装 Mini。

```sh
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.4.1_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh
```

The installer verifies and locally signs the app. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility when prompted. For Gitee downloads, replace `https://github.com` with `https://gitee.com` above. / 安装器会校验并本机签名，请按提示授予屏幕录制及辅助功能权限；使用 Gitee 下载时，将上方链接中的 `https://github.com` 替换为 `https://gitee.com`。
